what: Four photos covering the plate switch with a 2s blur transition (blur 32px, transparent → sharp) every 8s, and each section’s Ken Burns zooms in from 1.5x to natural size over 30s ease-out. The current section number and total are written to the children, and a Vegas timer line fills toward the next switch. Pressing a number dot jumps to that section.

options.[data-fx-part=stage]: The board to draw slides on (required) — the caller sets the size (100vh if it is the Hero)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Section (required, multiple) — data-src (photo URL) · data-src-narrow (photo for narrow screens) · data-label (text written on the placeholder image when there is no photo)
options.[data-fx-part=current] · [data-fx-part=t: (If any) Spot showing the current section number and total sections
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: (if present) button that jumps to that numbered section when pressed
options.transition · transition-dur: Vegas transition name · length (sec), default blur · 2
options.animation · animation-dur: Vegas section motion · duration (sec), default kenburns · 30
options.timer: none means the timer line is not drawn
options.narrow: Below this width (px) data-src-narrow is used, default 768

use:
… 1/
— On every slide change, fx:slide(detail.index)
note: Load jQuery and vegas.min.js · vegas.min.css from library/_vendor/vegas@2.6.0 first. Without photos, it bakes placeholder images in skin colors (--kf-surface · --kf-raised)

from.where: index.html .nj-hero (hero — four photos, Vegas transition blur · transitionDuration 2000 · delay 8000 · animation kenburns · animationDuration 30000, number and vertical timer line at bottom left)
